queries.scope: Locate official Odisha cadastral map and Rourkela municipal land service.
queries.result: Odisha Bhulekh/BhuNaksha is the government land-record and cadastral-map service. Its Map View asks users to select district, tahasil, village, RI circle and plot number; the official Rourkela Municipal Corporation provides a city map/topographic map page. The map flow is plot-specific, and no full anonymous polygon API schema was verified.

queries.scope: Verify official map workflow and local city linkage.
queries.result: Odisha’s official Bhulekh FAQ confirms that a parcel map is available through MapView. The public map viewer requires selected location and plot number; Bhulekh plot-specific map and property data are not an anonymous citywide geometry feed.
